LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.3: Print awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Print awareness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What pictures do you awareness learner should be able to: pictures and encouraged to talk about enjoy looking at?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’
2. Show interest in reading in and activities. out of school. • Learners could view pictures depicting a

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Print awareness

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Print awareness

Teach
• Focus skill: Demonstrate awareness of pictures. print in and out of school. • Learners could be engaged in ‘read aloud’.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Print awareness.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Print awareness
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What pictures do you awareness learner should be able to: pictures and encouraged to talk about enjoy looking at?
2. What pictures interest of school. • Learners could answer questions about learners?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
